svg.title: Verification receipt
svg.desc: The separate serialized clipboard diagnostic completed all 20 episodes, with full reward on 10/10 for each arm. It reused the original five seeds and paired goal text, with one episode at a time. Its ten native profiles, all Chromium profile directories and scoped process roots were absent in the final census. Model strategy and machine load varied; this does not prove clipboard contention caused the primary failures.
